row.team_price_text: Software free for all customers; fulfillment priced by custom quote
row.evidence: ShipBob's User Management Settings article has admins invite, edit and remove users by hand in Settings > User Management, with MFA as the only sign-in control; no SSO, SAML or SCIM appears in the help centre, the pricing page or the developer API reference.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. ShipBob is a fulfillment (3PL) service: its pricing page says the software is completely free for all customers and fulfillment is quoted per merchant, so price fields are null. Users are managed manually (Owner, Client Admin, Customer Success and Supply Chain, Customer Success- Billing Restricted roles); sign-in is email and password with optional enforced two-step authentication. Help-centre search for SSO returns only MFA, token and integration articles. The Developer API (PAT or OAuth 2.0; 150 requests/minute) covers orders, products, inventory, receiving, returns, billing, channels and webhooks, with no user endpoints. No Okta OIN app (404).

plans.price_text: Software completely free for all customers; fulfillment by custom quote

scim.notes: available=false by absence across the help centre, developer API index and pricing page.

rate_limits.text: 150 requests per minute (sliding window) per user, per application; 429 when exceeded.

user_api.notes: available=false: the API reference sections are Billing, Channels, Inventory, Locations, Orders, Products, Receiving, Returns, Tracking and Webhooks, with no user or team endpoints. Personal Access Tokens do not expire.

fallbacks.notes: Manual invites only; users are deactivated via Remove in User Management. Owners and Client Admins can enforce two-step authentication for all users.

citations.title: ShipBob Fulfillment Pricing
citations.quote: ShipBob's software is completely free for all customers, as well as connecting all turnkey integrations.

citations.title: ShipBob Fulfillment Pricing
citations.quote: Each ShipBob quote is customized to give you the most accurate rates possible, and also takes batchable orders, volume, and other factors into account.

citations.title: User Management Settings
citations.quote: Add new users: Invite new users to access your company's ShipBob dashboard.

citations.title: User Management Settings
citations.quote: Review the on-screen message and click Remove User (or Cancel to go back). A success message will appear to confirm that the user has been deactivated.

citations.title: Company Profile Settings
citations.quote: Enforce Two-Step Authentication for All Users: Allows Account Owners and Client Admins to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all users.

citations.title: ShipBob API Authentication
citations.quote: ShipBob's API supports two authentication methods: Personal Access Token (PAT) for single-user integrations and OAuth 2.0 for multi-user applications.

citations.title: ShipBob API Rate limit
citations.quote: API calls will be rate-limited to 150 requests per-minute using a sliding window, and will be totalled per user, per application across calls to any of the ShipBob APIs.
